_meta.purpose: Trigger and no-trigger contract for the Taskbean skill shipped in the v0.7 Copilot plugin, aligned to the outcome/evidence model (#113, #115, #117). skill.test.mjs checks the contract deterministically against the shipped SKILL.md text and replays each expected command sequence against an isolated Taskbean store. These are contract and proxy checks, not measured model behavior; model trigger rates need the opt-in live run described in README.md.

placeholders.<title>: An outcome-oriented task title chosen by the agent.
placeholders.<id>: The id returned by the preceding bean add --json call (or by setup_commands).
